responsibility: Provides shared MIR utilities used across rustc_mir for transforming and inspecting MIR, reporting MIR-based diagnostics, and rendering MIR for debugging. This includes helpers that expand aggregate assignments into primitive initialization steps, compute whether places may be unaligned through packed access, collect direct writes to locals, elaborate drop terminators into explicit drop-flag-driven control flow, detect self-receiver method calls, compute locals whose storage is always live, and stage/apply structured edits to MIR bodies. It also centralizes reusable borrow-checker diagnostic construction and supplies MIR visualization infrastructure by converting MIR bodies into generic graph forms, emitting generic and MIR-specific Graphviz output, pretty-printing and dumping MIR, generating spanview HTML tied back to source spans, and exposing this utility surface through the module’s re-exports.
